title: Chapter 107 Conflict
content:
Chapter 107 Conflict

In the deserted city.

At this time, people were still cheering.

But at this moment, Huang Shou on the city wall was extremely tense, and his eyes were solemnly looking at the woman in front of him who could not feel any breath at all.

"Who are you?"

Huang Shou said in a deep voice.

But the woman did not answer, but just raised her hand slightly.

laugh!

A strand of hair slowly floated down from Huangshou's ears.

The woman entered the deserted city directly.

When he was still there, Huang Shou was stunned for a moment and reached out to take the strand of hair.

After a long silence, Huang Shou sighed.

He turned to look in the direction of the city lord's mansion, his face a little bitter.

He really can't beat this.

In the city lord's mansion, Lu Daosheng had now recovered his original strength in the true self realm.

Seeing the abnormality, Lu Daosheng felt it slightly and was stunned.

Is it her?

"What’s wrong with you?"

On the side, the young man from the Time and Space Hall said in confusion.

Lu Daosheng's aura was so powerful just now, why did he suddenly return to peace now?

But he didn't dare to say anything more.

Because he guessed that Lu Daosheng was most likely the kind of red dust immortal that was rare in the world, and he had hidden his strength and walked in this lower world.

Otherwise, how could Lu Daosheng easily take over the power of the immortal path with one blow?

Lu Daosheng ignored him and said indifferently: "You can leave now."

Hearing this, the young man pursed his lips and said, "What, if you need anything, just call me at any time. I am not busy at ordinary times, and I can be at any time."

This is extremely humble.

But this is a characteristic that everyone in the Time and Space Hall has.

There is no way. If you want to continue climbing up, you rely on opportunities, and opportunities may lie in the people you come into contact with by chance.

Socializing and showing goodwill.

After saying that, the young man disappeared directly.

At this time, a special guest suddenly entered the city lord's mansion.

The woman walked in the small road of the city lord's mansion and regarded all restrictions as nothing.

What's even more strange is that until now, no guard in the mansion has stood up to stop her.

Gradually, the woman's eyes gradually became lost.

It's him, what happened?

"Sister, who are you looking for?"

At this moment, a voice sounded behind itself.

The woman looked at her with a puzzled look when she heard the sound.

For some reason, she always felt that the woman in front of her felt familiar.

"you,,"

When the woman saw Lu Xue, her delicate body trembled.

Looking at the face that was seventy-sixth-slightly similar to her in front of her, the woman's eyes suddenly turned red.

"come over."

The woman waved to Lu Xue, and a faint smile appeared on her face.

Upon hearing this, Lu Xue hesitated for a moment, then slowly walked towards the woman.

"Sister, do we know each other?"

Lu Xue walked to the woman and spoke.

At this time, the woman hugged Lu Xue directly.

Lu Xue was stunned when she hugged her.

At this time, Lu Xue's mind was blank.

After a long time, the woman let go of Lu Xue, then picked up Lu Xue's little face, smiled bitterly, "Yes, the foundation is very solid, and she looks even more beautiful than when I was young."

At this time, she seemed to remember something, and her face became bitter again.

Seeing the woman in front of her, Lu Xue remained silent. No matter how stupid she was, she could guess something.

"Spiritual rhyme."

At this moment, Lu Daosheng's voice sounded from the side.

Hearing this extremely familiar voice, the woman's body trembled slightly, and then she instantly recovered her expression and turned her head to look over.

"Lingyun, it's really you, you're back."

At this time, Lu Daosheng looked at the woman in front of him with red eyes, unable to believe it.

His wife, Yan Lingyun, has finally come back.

Seeing Lu Daosheng like this, Yan Lingyun felt a throbbing in her heart, but she immediately suppressed her.

"It's me."

Yan Lingyun said in a faint voice.

"Lingyun, tell me, why did you leave without saying goodbye back then?"

Although he noticed something was wrong with Yan Lingyun, Lu Daosheng didn't care, but asked the question he wanted to know most for so many years.

Why did you leave without saying goodbye?

He always believed that the other party must have his own difficulties.

Hearing Lu Daosheng's words, Yan Lingyun was silent.

"Is it important?"

“To me, it’s very important.”

Lu Daosheng spoke.

Hearing this, Yan Lingyun slowly closed her eyes, as if she had made up her mind and said, "We are not people from the same world."

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng was stunned.

Not a person from the same world.

"Is this your answer?"

Lu Daosheng said with a complicated expression.

At this moment, it is fake not to feel heartbroken.

The answer I have been waiting for for so many years is so heartbreaking.

"Lingyun, do you have any difficulties? Tell me, we,"

At this time, Lu Daosheng felt a little unstoppable.

Before he finished speaking, Yan Lingyun had already turned around.

"You are just a burden to follow me."

As soon as these words came out, Lu Daosheng closed his mouth.

Looking at Yan Lingyun for a long time, Lu Daosheng said slowly, "Why are the hairpin on your head worn until now?"

That wooden hairpin was the first gift Lu Daosheng gave to Yan Lingyun.

Since you said that, why do you still have to bring the wooden hairpin I gave me?

Hearing Lu Daosheng's question, Yan Lingyun was silent for a moment, then took off the wooden hairpin on her head, threw it directly on the ground, and then left.

Seeing this scene, Lu Daosheng shook his head and smiled.

It was just a smile, extremely bitter.

Then, Lu Daosheng turned and left, his back looked inexplicably desolate, as if he had aged a lot.

In this way, only Lu Xue, who was stunned in the same place, and the hairpin on the ground were left.

Tears slowly slid down from the corners of her eyes, and Lu Xue looked a little helpless at this moment.

Good news, her mother who she hadn't seen for a long time is back.

Bad news, her mother left again just a few minutes after she came back.

I didn't even have time to say a word to her.

And at this moment, a figure came back again.

Yan Lingyun.

Yan Lingyun looked indifferent, walked straight to Lu Xue's side, picked up the wooden hairpin on the ground, and turned away again.

But Lu Xue noticed that Yan Lingyun's face was slightly red.

"Mother..."

Looking at Yan Lingyun who was about to leave, Lu Xue choked up.

Hearing Lu Xue's words, Yan Lingyun's body trembled slightly. After a moment of silence, Yan Lingyun walked in front of Lu Xue, wiped Lu Xue's tears, and whispered: "Be obedient, stay with your father, and tell him to drink less."

Then Yan Lingyun took out another dragon talisman and stuffed it into Lu Xue's hand.

"If you encounter a danger that your father can't solve, crush it. No matter how far, mother will come to save you."

After saying that, Yan Lingyun's figure trembled and disappeared directly on the spot.

This time, Yan Lingyun really left.

On the spot, Lu Xue looked at the dragon talisman in her hand that still carried the breath of her mother, and her heart was extremely complicated.

She wanted to ask why she couldn't be with us.

However, Yan Lingyun had already disappeared at this time.

As if she had thought of something, Lu Xue walked towards the mansion.

Soon, Lu Xue found her father.

Lu Daosheng was already sitting in his room, and the table was filled with bottles of wine.

These wines were provided by the system. No matter how strong you are, you will get drunk after drinking.

Seeing that her father was really drinking to relieve his sorrow, Lu Xue understood even more.

Her father and mother both had each other in their hearts, but why was this the case?

She believed that what her mother said to her father must be false.

"Dad, why don't you go after mother?"

Seeing her father like this, Lu Xue hesitated.

She didn't want to see her father and mother have such a big conflict.
